Question: Some time i am using ashesh (Charas) like smoking i am not getting mast or out of control i am getting/going very deep in every thing especialy when i am reading Adith Sharif or Prayer i am going too deep i deeply feels Allah power and Rasol allah (PBUH)kindness even some time i cry what is the hokom for this? Answer ID: 2409 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 99/94=B) It is makrooh - e-Tahreemi (undesirable to an extent of haram ) to consume charas (hashish) if it is used in a quantity which does not intoxicate, otherwise taking it in an intoxicating quantity is unlawful and haram. Moreover, it causes resemblance with the people of Hell since they will also discharge smoke from their mouth, thus it is disliked by Allah. As far as the matter of hashish helps to concentrate more on studies is concerned, it is your baseless obsession. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
